title: Mathematics
text: NCERT Class X mathematics covering algebra, geometry, trigonometry, mensuration, statistics, and probability.

title: Real Numbers
text: Number systems, Euclid's algorithm, irrational numbers, and properties of real numbers. Topics: Euclid's Division Lemma, Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, Irrational Numbers, Decimal Representations.

title: Polynomials
text: Polynomial operations, zeroes, and algebraic identities. Topics: Degree of Polynomial, Zeroes of Polynomial, Remainder Theorem, Factor Theorem.

path: Mathematics > Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
text: Solve linear systems using substitution, elimination, and graphical methods. Topics: Graphical Method, Substitution Method, Elimination Method, Applications in Word Problems.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

title: Quadratic Equations
text: Quadratic equations, discriminant, nature of roots, and applications in real life. Topics: Standard Form of Quadratic Equation, Discriminant, Nature of Roots, Applications of Quadratic Equations.

title: Arithmetic Progressions
text: Arithmetic sequences, nth term, sum of n terms, and applications. Topics: nth Term of an AP, Sum of First n Terms, Arithmetic Mean.

title: Triangles
text: Similarity of triangles, Pythagoras theorem, and basic proportionality. Topics: Similarity of Triangles, Pythagoras Theorem, Areas of Similar Triangles.

title: Coordinate Geometry
text: Distance formula, section formula, and area of triangles in the coordinate plane. Topics: Distance Formula, Section Formula, Area of a Triangle.

title: Introduction to Trigonometry
text: Trigonometric ratios of acute angles and basic identities. Topics: Sine, Cosine, Tangent, Reciprocal Ratios, Trigonometric Identities.

title: Some Applications of Trigonometry
text: Heights and distances, angles of elevation and depression. Topics: Angle of Elevation, Angle of Depression, Height and Distance Problems.

title: Circles
text: Tangent, cyclic quadrilaterals, and angle properties of circles. Topics: Tangent and Secant, Angle Subtended by an Arc, Cyclic Quadrilaterals.

title: Constructions
text: Construction of triangles, bisectors, and tangents to circles. Topics: Triangle Construction, Angle Bisector, Circle Tangent.

title: Areas Related to Circles
text: Area of circles, sectors, segments, and combinations of plane figures. Topics: Area of a Circle, Area of a Sector, Area of a Segment.

title: Surface Areas and Volumes
text: Surface area and volume of solids like cuboids, cylinders, cones, and spheres. Topics: Surface Area of Solids, Volume of Solids, Conversion between Shapes.

title: Statistics
text: Collection, presentation and analysis of data using mean, median and mode. Topics: Mean of Grouped Data, Median of Grouped Data, Mode of Grouped Data.

title: Probability
text: Probability of events, experimental and theoretical probability of simple events. Topics: Probability of an Event, Sample Space, Complementary Events.

title: Physics
text: NCERT Class X physics covering light, electricity, magnetism, and energy resources.

title: Light - Reflection and Refraction
text: Reflection, refraction, mirrors, lenses and ray diagrams. Topics: Laws of Reflection, Refraction and Snell's Law, Spherical Mirrors, Lens Formula.

path: Physics > Human Eye and Colourful World
title: Human Eye and Colourful World
text: Structure of the eye, defects of vision, and dispersion of light. Topics: Structure of the Eye, Defects of Vision, Dispersion of Light, Rainbow Formation.

title: Electricity
text: Current, resistance, Ohm's law, circuit diagrams, and power in electrical circuits. Topics: Ohm's Law, Series and Parallel Circuits, Electrical Power, Heating Effects of Current.

path: Physics > Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
title: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
text: Magnetic fields around current-carrying conductors, electromagnets, and electric motors. Topics: Magnetic Field Lines, Fleming's Left Hand Rule, Electromagnets, Electric Motors.

title: Sources of Energy
text: Renewable and non-renewable energy sources, energy security, and environmental impact. Topics: Fossil Fuels, Solar Energy, Hydroelectric Power, Energy Conservation.

title: Chemistry
text: NCERT Class X chemistry covering reactions, acids and bases, metals and their compounds, organic compounds, and periodicity.

title: Chemical Reactions and Equations
text: Types of chemical reactions, balancing equations, and activity series. Topics: Types of Reactions, Balancing Chemical Equations, Exothermic and Endothermic Reactions.

title: Acids, Bases and Salts
text: Properties of acids and bases, pH scale, and neutralization reactions. Topics: Characteristics of Acids and Bases, pH Scale, Neutralization.

title: Metals and Non-metals
text: Physical and chemical properties of metals and non-metals, reactivity series, and corrosion. Topics: Physical Properties of Metals, Reactivity Series, Metallic and Non-metallic Behaviour.

title: Carbon and Its Compounds
text: Organic chemistry basics, covalent bonding, and hydrocarbon families. Topics: Covalent Bonding, Hydrocarbons, Functional Groups.

title: Periodic Classification of Elements
text: Modern periodic table, periodic trends, and properties of elements. Topics: Periodic Table, Periodic Trends, Groups and Periods.

title: Biology
text: NCERT Class X biology covering life processes, control and coordination, reproduction, heredity, and environmental conservation.

title: Life Processes
text: Nutrition, respiration, transportation, and excretion in living organisms. Topics: Nutrition, Respiration, Transportation, Excretion.

title: Control and Coordination
text: Nervous and hormonal coordination in animals and plants. Topics: Nervous System, Endocrine System, Plant Hormones.

title: How Do Organisms Reproduce?
text: Asexual and sexual reproduction in plants and animals. Topics: Asexual Reproduction, Sexual Reproduction, Reproductive Structures.

title: Heredity and Evolution
text: Inheritance patterns, Mendel's laws, and the theory of evolution. Topics: Mendelian Genetics, Variation, Natural Selection.

title: Natural Resources
text: Conservation and sustainable use of air, water, forests, and natural ecosystems. Topics: Air and Water Resources, Forest Resources, Sustainable Use.
